newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks close up, led by fuel scrips.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks close up, led by fuel scrips.

text.p: Pakistani stocks closed sharply up on Tuesday's settlement day led by fuel and power scrips, dealers at the Karachi Stock Exchange (KSE) said.
Bellwether stocks in the fuel and power sector, which posted handsome gains, pushed the index up, dealer Ali Raza said. "We expect rising trend on Wednesday's new accounts day."
The KSE 100-share index closed up 19.97 points or 1.11 percent at 1,814.61. There were 136 losers and 92 gainers.
PSO jumped 12 rupees to 405, Shell Pakistan 5.50 to 272, Hub Power 0.25 to 51.70 and Karachi Electric 0.80 to 20.80.
